scope: Failure messages name the resource and action; document, history and media are preserved
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none
verified_behaviors: Missing audio server: message names the remote and target, says project and history are kept and offers Retry audio; Save still works
Save into a missing folder and over another existing file: 'Could not save NAME', edits kept, save again; state unchanged
Open of a missing, malformed and future-feature file: 'Could not open NAME' with the reason, open project unchanged, choose another; state unchanged
Import of a 44.1 kHz WAV: 'Could not import odd-rate.wav' with the 48000 reason, track unchanged; decoded audio kept
Export over an existing file (left byte-identical), with an unsupported format and into a missing folder: 'Could not export NAME', no file left
Missing audio on open is named with a relink or import action; Relink to the moved file restores the source
Injected write, sync and rename save faults: message names the file, preserves the previous file, keeps edits and history
limits: No plugin failures exist yet (#72); device-loss behaviour on physical hardware is #25.
